features.title: Quick Search
features.summary: Global search bar that instantly finds employees, contracts, and records across all modules.
features.content:
The **Quick Search** feature provides a unified search experience across the entire Smart HR system.

### How it works
- Located in the top navigation bar, accessible from any page
- Searches across employee names, IDs, contract numbers, and more
- Results are grouped by category (Employee, Contract, Attendance)
- Click on a result to navigate directly to that record

### Configuration
- Search is enabled by default for all users
- Results are filtered by the user's permission level
- Maximum 20 results per category

features.title: Employee Profile
features.summary: Comprehensive employee information management with customizable fields and sections.
features.content:
The **Employee Profile** is the central hub for all employee data.

### Key Sections
- **Personal Info**: Name, DOB, gender, contact details
- **Employment**: Position, department, employment type, status
- **Documents**: Upload and manage employee documents
- **Custom Fields**: Add organization-specific fields

### Features
- Profile photo upload with auto-resize
- Employment history tracking
- Multi-language support for names
- Bulk import via Excel

features.title: Employee Contract
features.summary: Contract lifecycle management including creation, renewal, and termination tracking.
features.content:
Manage the full lifecycle of employment contracts.

### Contract Types
- Employment Contract
- Probation Contract
- Fixed-term Contract
- Internship Agreement

### Features
- Auto-generated contract numbers (CTN-XXXXXX)
- Duration calculation from start/end dates
- File attachment support (up to 10 files)
- Contract renewal workflow
- Expiry notification alerts
